links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy and number of interaction turns of abstention approaches in multi-round clinical benchmarks
links.effect: KnowGuard improved diagnostic accuracy by 3.93% and reduced unnecessary interaction by 7.27 turns on average versus state-of-the-art abstention approaches.
links.quote: Experimental evidences clearly demonstrate that KnowGuard outperforms state-of-the-art abstention approaches, improving diagnostic accuracy by 3.93\% while reducing unnecessary interaction by 7.27 turns on average.

unlisted_practices: Knowledge graph-based evidence exploration (investigate-before-abstain) to support LLM abstention when clinical information is insufficient

screen.reason: Evaluates KnowGuard, a knowledge-driven abstention safeguard added to LLMs to prevent overconfident clinical decisions when information is incomplete, tested on multi-round clinical benchmarks.
